external_entities.name: colleague
external_entities.description: A colleague who signs in through the identity broker.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are, including their own devices at home.
external_entities.notes: The text does not state whether colleagues use a second factor.

external_entities.name: franchise colleague
external_entities.description: A colleague from a franchise store who is vouched for by the franchise identity provider.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Franchise colleagues do not have staff accounts with us; their own identity provider vouches for them and the broker takes that as a sign-in.

external_entities.name: franchise identity provider
external_entities.description: The identity provider used by franchise colleagues.
external_entities.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them
external_entities.notes: The text does not state which colleagues this provider is allowed to vouch for.

external_entities.name: HR system
external_entities.description: The system that supplies group-membership changes to the identity broker overnight.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Group membership is not maintained there by hand — it comes from the HR system overnight.

external_entities.name: store
external_entities.description: A store against which the store admin console can operate.
external_entities.source_excerpt: a store-manager token works against every store
external_entities.notes: The text names stores generally and separately refers to franchise stores; it does not state the control boundary for stores.

processes.name: identity broker
processes.description: Signs colleagues in, issues tokens, validates federated sign-ins, signs tokens, and supplies public signing keys.
processes.source_excerpt: Everything colleagues use signs them in through one identity broker.
processes.notes: Nothing calls back to the broker to ask whether a colleague is still allowed in. Tokens are good for twelve hours and there is no way to pull one back before they expire.

processes.name: application
processes.description: An application that takes the issued token and decides what the colleague may do from its groups.
processes.source_excerpt: Every application takes that token and decides what the colleague may do from the groups in it.

processes.name: store admin console
processes.description: An application that lets a holder with the store-manager group change prices and void transactions.
processes.source_excerpt: The store admin console is one of those applications.
processes.notes: The console does not check which store the colleague belongs to, so a store-manager token works against every store.

data_stores.name: key store
data_stores.description: The key store containing the identity broker's token-signing key.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.

data_stores.name: directory
data_stores.description: The identity broker's directory of colleagues and their groups.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.

data_stores.name: audit log
data_stores.description: The audit log to which the broker writes sign-ins.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_stores.notes: Nobody has written down what the log records or whether it covers the franchise route. Nobody has written down whether the log is encrypted where it sits.

data_flows.name: sign-in
data_flows.description: A colleague signs in to the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are
data_flows.data_description: Colleague sign-in information

data_flows.name: issue token
data_flows.description: The identity broker issues a token to a colleague.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Once the broker has signed a colleague in it issues them a token.
data_flows.notes: The token carries the colleague's staff id and a list of the groups they are in.
data_flows.data_description: Token containing staff id and group membership

data_flows.name: present token
data_flows.description: A colleague presents the issued token to an application.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every application takes that token
data_flows.data_description: Token containing staff id and group membership

data_flows.name: fetch public key
data_flows.description: An application fetches the public half of the signing key from the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Applications fetch the public half from the broker to check the signature.
data_flows.data_description: Public half of the token-signing key

data_flows.name: provide public key
data_flows.description: The identity broker provides an application with the public half of the signing key.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Applications fetch the public half from the broker to check the signature.
data_flows.data_description: Public half of the token-signing key

data_flows.name: present token
data_flows.description: A colleague presents a token to the store admin console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: If the token has the store-manager group in it, the console lets the holder change prices and void transactions.
data_flows.data_description: Token containing staff id and group membership

data_flows.name: change prices and void transactions
data_flows.description: The store admin console changes prices and voids transactions at a store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: the console lets the holder change prices and void transactions
data_flows.notes: The console does not check which store the colleague belongs to, so a store-manager token works against every store.
data_flows.data_description: Prices and transactions

data_flows.name: pull group membership
data_flows.description: The identity broker pulls colleague and group-membership changes from the HR system's directory.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker pulls the changes once a night
data_flows.notes: The source says the changes come from the HR system but does not explicitly describe a separate HR data store.
data_flows.data_description: Colleagues and group-membership changes

data_flows.name: request vouching
data_flows.description: A franchise colleague uses the franchise identity provider for sign-in.
data_flows.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them
data_flows.data_description: Franchise colleague sign-in information

data_flows.name: vouch for colleague
data_flows.description: The franchise identity provider vouches for a franchise colleague to the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them and the broker takes that as a sign-in
data_flows.notes: The text does not state which colleagues the provider is allowed to vouch for.
data_flows.data_description: Federated sign-in assertion for a franchise colleague

data_flows.name: write sign-in
data_flows.description: The identity broker writes sign-ins to the audit log.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_flows.notes: It is unknown what the log records and whether it covers the franchise route.
data_flows.data_description: Sign-in audit records

data_flows.name: keep signing key
data_flows.description: The identity broker keeps its token-signing key in the key store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.
data_flows.data_description: Token-signing key

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network where the identity broker and store admin console run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The broker runs on the corporate network.

trust_boundaries.name: own devices at home
trust_boundaries.description: The boundary represented by colleagues' own devices at home.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: including their own devices at home
trust_boundaries.notes: The text says colleagues sign in from wherever they are; it does not place the colleagues themselves in this boundary.

trust_boundaries.name: franchise
trust_boundaries.description: The boundary containing the franchise identity provider and franchise colleagues' identity environment.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: We also let the franchise stores in.
